title: Sand mined vs. sand naturally replaced by rivers, per year

source.name: Global sediment flux studies (Milliman & Farnsworth river sediment estimates) cited in UNEP Sand and Sustainability reporting
source.publisher: United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) / peer-reviewed river-sediment literature

notes: UNEP estimates roughly 50 billion tonnes of sand and gravel are extracted worldwide per year, while the world's rivers are estimated to carry only about 12-13 billion tonnes of new sediment to the coasts annually (a figure further reduced by dams). Extraction is estimated at roughly 4x the natural replacement rate; treated here as approximate.
